note: Proposed, not sealed. The operator, in a desk session, on flatten phase F3 (one seal). The record in full: willows-grove docs/design/one-script/flatten-2026-10-19.md.

decisions.question: StorySession let a person reject a proposed fact; the one-script could only seal. How is a rejection made: a new one-script verb, two proposals per decision, or no rejection at all?
decisions.commitment: A one-script verb: the human's proof (or Nestor pair) over reject:<proposal subject>, recorded as durably as a seal, writing nothing. The story moves on REJECTED. A sealed proposal can't be rejected and a rejected one can't be sealed.
decisions.why: The operator: "1 a". It keeps 'a rejection is recorded as durably as an approval' in one place; two proposals per decision would double every decision's proposals.
